railTitle.description: The `harness flow rail` line for the authored flow; expected to start with [the-flow].

railClean.description: True if the rail line contains no Workshop/ADR text (excursions excluded from the spine).

workshopsAsExcursions.description: True if every node of type workshop/adr has a non-empty branch_of.

spineShape.description: Ordered node types of the main spine (nodes WITHOUT branch_of), e.g. [research, plan, phase].

navUsed.description: True if position was advanced with `harness flow nav set` (the migrated surface).

cursorCalled.description: MUST be false. True means the skill told you to run the removed `harness flow cursor` verb.

validates.description: True if `harness flow render` on the flow exits 0 (no E300/E308/E309).

flowPath.description: Absolute path to the authored throwaway flight plan ($OUT/the-flow.json).

stateFileAbsent.description: True iff NO .the-flow-state.json exists under $OUT after the drive (migrated the-flow eliminates the hand-written state file). The deterministic scorer re-checks the filesystem.

resumeDerivedPosition.description: The nav.now node id a cold resume derives from the flight plan alone (no state file); empty if not derivable.

summary.description: What happened end to end: did the migrated skill drive cleanly to a [the-flow] rail with the workshop as an excursion?

confusing.description: Where the migrated skill stalled or was ambiguous to drive autonomously — a finding for the prompt-tune loop.

magicWand.description: The single the-flow PROMPT edit that would most reduce the friction you hit (specific, your own words).
